name: screenwriting-en
description: English edition of 26 skills in four layers — general dramaturgy (project workflow and story bible, story structure, premise and theme, character and conflict psychology, dialogue, scene craft, format and adaptation, Truby organic story anatomy and genre anatomy), the medium layer (series: episode and season structure, series engine and bible, writers' room, half-hour comedy; stage: Chinese opera, banqiang and qupai methods with two full-script case libraries), tradition and trade (American case studies, Japanese method, Korean and French method, mainland-Chinese series practice and production chain, industry and business), and master corpora (Chekhov dramaturgy, Ozu screenplay style, Succession ensemble writing, television case studies) — distilled from 47 books and 23 volumes of published scripts and opera scores. Output language follows the user's question; craft terms are anchored to their original English via sw-workflow/terms.md.
